text:
maya: Quick sync — planning to enable pegasus-v3 in the model catalog canary for eu-west-1 at 10:00 PST (5% traffic). Need to update the precedence matrix so fallbacks go to the new quant variant first, then legacy 7b, then llama-lite. Will also pin the older quant for a subset of callers.

ashwin: Ack. I'll open a tiny config PR to change the precedence ordering and add a pinset for legacy clients. PR: https://github.com/redwood/configs/pull/4821

kevin: Re telemetry — please attach "pegasus-smoke-v2" eval set and gate on >3% drop in acceptance rate or a 150ms p50 latency regression. If triggered, auto-rollback to previous precedence.

maya: Good. Lina — can you add the alert policies and a quick dashboard? We want token-level cost delta too. @lina

lina: On it. Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/pegasus/pegasus-v3-canary (will share panel ids). Will add cost, p50/p95, and accept_rate.

deploy-bot: [deploy queued] model-catalog:enable pegasus-v3 canary (eu-west-1, 5%) — requested by maya

maya: small ops note: canary should exclude high-sla customers (pinlist) and keep dedicated capacity traffic on existing model. We'll use pinset "pegasus-exempt-2026-03"

ashwin: PR #4821 updates precedence matrix::

```yaml
models:
  - name: pegasus-v3
    precedence:
      - pegasus-v3-quant
      - pegasus-7b
      - llama-lite
pinsets:
  pegasus-exempt-2026-03: [client:legacy-search, client:billing-api]
```

ashwin: cc @kevin for gating labels in the PR description.

deploy-bot: [canary started] model-catalog:enable pegasus-v3 canary -> 05% traffic in eu-west-1. canary_id=canary-20260321-01

kevin: Metrics booting. Starting eval run against "pegasus-smoke-v2" set. Will update here in ~10m.

maya: If we observe any silent failures (504s, malformed outputs) we rollback immediately. No manual fiddling with precedence during the 30m window unless an oncall signs off.

sre-bot: Auto-watch enabled for canary-20260321-01: error_rate > 0.5% OR output_validation_failures > 0.2% triggers auto rollback check.

lina: Dashboard panels populated. Linking smoke test logs and sample responses panel. :eyes:

kevin: smoke run 1 complete: accept_rate delta = -0.8% (within threshold), p50 latency +20ms. No output validation failures. Posting full diff to the PR.

maya: Great. Proceed to 30m observation. If all green, we'll expand to 20% tomorrow morning and schedule a full enable next week.

ashwin: Merging PR now. Will also update the release note: "Enabled pegasus-v3 (quant first fallback) in eu-west-1 canary. Pinlist applied for legacy clients."

deploy-bot: [deploy succeeded] model-catalog:enable pegasus-v3 canary -> merged and active. rollout_state=canary_running

lina: small UX note — we should surface precedence changes in the Console (model view) so customers see the active fallback chain. Filed FE ticket #1009.

maya: Good catch. Add it to the follow-up list. For now, notify solutions-eng and CS about the change and the pinset.

ashwin: Notifying via email + slack channel. draft note: "Pegasus v3 canary enabled in eu-west-1 (5%). Fallback precedence: pegasus-v3-quant -> pegasus-7b -> llama-lite. Legacy clients on pinset pegasus-exempt-2026-03."

kevin: Monitoring continues. If any of our gating metrics breach, we'll trigger the rollback playbook:

1) deploy-bot rollback canary-20260321-01
2) revert precedence PR and reapply old pinsets
3) notify SRE and Product

maya: Let's hope not but ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: canary-20260321-01 heartbeat OK. next_check=5881234580

kevin: 20m check: accept_rate delta = -0.2%, p95 +30ms, costs +1.5%. All within tolerances.

maya: Closing thread for now — we'll reconvene if anything pops. Documented in the cutover notes and release tracker.

ashwin: Adding a quick rollback-criteria snippet to the release notes before we close.

lina: FYI CS notified. :white_check_mark:
